webEvidence.description: What a sensor saw when it fetched this asset. Screenshots are kept for 30 days when your organization turned them on.
webEvidence.settings.description: Keep the screenshots that sensors with the screenshot tool take of your web assets, for 30 days. A screenshot shows whatever the page shows, so this is off by default. Status, title and a short masked response are kept either way.
webEvidence.settings.title: Screenshots of web assets
